relations.text: MACOMは、Goldman Sachs Bank USAを管理代理人とするクレジット契約(2014年5月8日付)の当事者だった
relations.text_en: MACOM was party to a credit agreement dated May 8, 2014 with a syndicate of lenders and Goldman Sachs Bank USA as administrative agent

source.label: MACOM Technology Solutions 10-K
source.quote: We were party to a credit agreement dated as of May 8, 2014, with a syndicate of lenders and Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as administrative agent (as amended on February 13, 2015, August 31, 2016, March 10, 2017, May 19, 2017, May 2, 2018 and May 9, 2018, the “Credit Agreement”).
source.note: 過去の契約で、資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: マコム・テクノロジー・ソリューションズの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in MACOM’s annual report

source.label: MACOM Technology Solutions 10-K
source.quote: While we compete with a wide variety of companies, our significant competitors include, among others , ADI, Broadcom, Credo, Marvell, MaxLinear, Microchip, NXP, Qorvo, Semtech, Skyworks and Sumitomo as well as increased competition from Chinese companies.
